title: Ramoops oops/panic logger (kernel docs)

title: Fallback mechanisms (kernel firmware loader docs)
takes: the user-mode-helper firmware fallback times out after 60 s by default (/sys/class/firmware/timeout)

title: Partition layout: system-as-root (source.android.com)
takes: system-as-root cmdline is 'ro root=/dev/dm-0 rootwait skip_initramfs init=/init dm=...': the kernel ignores the boot ramdisk and runs /init from the system partition

title: Magisk issues 8063 and 4307: bootloader adds skip_initramfs
takes: a bootloader can add skip_initramfs itself (to the cmdline or the dtb bootargs) so a swapped ramdisk is ignored

title: Qualcomm Linux debug: log analysis (subsystem watchdog bark/bite, SSR)
takes: signatures: 'subsys-restart: ... restart_level = SYSTEM' followed by 'Kernel panic - not syncing: subsys-restart: Resetting the SoC - X crashed'

title: Pixel 2/3/4 Android Debug Cable how-to (Peter-Easton)
takes: USB-C passthrough breakout + FT232 TTL cable (GND A1, RX A8, TX B8, VCC unused); 'fastboot oem uart enable' (bootloader unlocked) then /dev/ttyUSB0 at 115200; 'fastboot oem uart disable' after; uart stays on even if the bootloader is re-locked

title: Nura wiki: serial debugging cable schematics (Pixel 2 section)
takes: Pixel 2 (walleye) tested with the Android Debug Cable; SuzyQable does not work; bootloader and kernel logs come over UART after 'fastboot oem uart enable'; UART level 1.8 V

title: Build Pixel kernels (AOSP): wahoo kernel branch

takes: ncm_alloc_inst only kzallocs opts (opts->net stays NULL); the net_device is made in ncm_bind at UDC bind; ncm_alloc does refcnt++

title: kernel/msm android-msm-wahoo-4.4-android11: u_ether_configfs.h
takes: dev_addr/host_addr/qmult/ifname store: -EBUSY if refcnt, else gether_set_*(opts->net) with no NULL check

title: drivers/usb/gadget/function/f_fs.c (v4.4.302 and v7.3): descriptor parser
author: Linux kernel (GPL-2.0)
takes: ffs_do_single_desc accepts only interface, endpoint, HID, OTG, interface-association and SS companion descriptors; class-specific (0x24 CS_INTERFACE) falls to default -EINVAL in both v4.4.302 and v7.3; interface numbers are remapped by usb_interface_id (single function in a config starts at 0); a configfs bind returns -ENODEV until the descriptors are written (desc_ready)

title: drivers/usb/class/cdc-acm.c: acm_probe without functional descriptors
author: Linux kernel (GPL-2.0)
takes: with no union descriptor and an interface of class 2 subclass 2 with exactly three endpoints, probe assumes a single combined interface and finds interrupt-in, bulk-in, bulk-out by usb_find_common_endpoints: no CDC functional descriptors needed

title: tools/usb/ffs-test.c and Documentation/usb/functionfs.rst
author: Samsung Electronics, Linux kernel (GPL-2.0-or-later)
takes: descriptor blob layout: header (magic V2, flags FS|HS|SS, counts), then fs, hs, ss descriptor lists; strings blob with FUNCTIONFS_STRINGS_MAGIC; ep0 event loop

title: libufdt ufdt_overlay.c (AOSP)
author: AOSP
takes: With any property in an overlay's __fixups__, a base dtb without a __symbols__ node is an error ('No node __symbols__ in main dtb'): the merge fails

title: Enabling serial port (console UART) on Pixel 2 and other Pixels
author: bacon.dev
takes: Pixel 2 UART on USB-C SBU1/SBU2 at 1.8 V, 115200 8N1, fastboot oem uart enable; the stock cable lacks the lines; orientation differs between Pixels

title: Pixel KGDB over UART
author: Andrey Konovalov
takes: USB-Cereal at 1.8 V and 115200 on a Pixel 8; an FT232R supports break (KGDB sysrq), a CP2102N edition did not

title: usb-cereal
author: Google
takes: SBU1 = TX, SBU2 = RX, DIP 1.8/3.3 V (a wrong setting can damage the target), orientation-specific, archived 2023-01-10, not an official Google product

title: msm-poweroff.c, kernel/msm android-msm-wahoo-4.4-android11 (vendor restart path)
takes: msm_restart_prepare: PMIC reset type is WARM only if download mode is on (panic sets it) or the reboot command is non-empty; a plain reboot is a PMIC HARD reset, 'unless memory contents must be maintained'; panic path can bite the watchdog; PS_HOLD de-asserted through TZ

title: drivers/firmware/psci/psci.c psci_sys_reset (mainline)
takes: reboot=warm/soft uses SYSTEM_RESET2 only if psci_system_reset2_supported (PSCI 1.1); otherwise plain SYSTEM_RESET; notifier priority 129

title: drivers/power/reset/qcom-pon.c (mainline)
takes: mainline pm8998-pon driver only registers reboot-mode (writes the soft spare reason); it never programs the PS_HOLD reset type (warm/hard), unlike the vendor qpnp_pon_system_pwr_off

title: Qualcomm docs: PMIC PON reset status
takes: PON_WARM_RESET_REASON / PON_ON_REASON 0x40 = warm-reset sequence; SDI runs PS_HOLD warm resets before a RAM dump: the PMIC records which kind of reset happened, readable after boot

title: drivers/watchdog/qcom-wdt.c (mainline)
takes: qcom,kpss-wdt: restart handler (priority 128, below PSCI's 129) and a bite on an unpetted watchdog; the lab dts already has the node at 0x17817000

title: openwrt#5045: ramoops files survive a warm reboot, not a cold one
takes: plain statement of the rule on a Qualcomm SoC (ipq806x): pstore survives warm, not cold reset
